prompt: The script adds a class 'open' to show the menu.
why: JavaScript changing an element's classes is changing the page.
trap: A click may start it, but the clue is the change.

prompt: The counter's text changes from 3 to 4 when an item is added.
why: Updating text in an element is changing the DOM.
trap: Something triggered it; the clue is the change.

prompt: The code creates a new li and appends it to the list.
tells: creates a new li and appends it
why: Adding elements with JavaScript is changing the page.
trap: It uses the tree, but the clue is creating.

prompt: Closing the banner removes the element from the page.
tells: removes the element from the page
why: Removing elements is changing the DOM.
trap: Hiding with CSS is different; this removes it.

prompt: Putting user comments in with innerHTML let someone inject a script.
why: innerHTML writes HTML into the page, so untrusted text is risky. That's changing the DOM.
trap: The comment came from a form, but the danger is how it's inserted.

prompt: A dark mode switch flips a class on the body, and CSS does the rest.
tells: flips a class on the body
why: Changing a class from JavaScript is updating the page.
trap: CSS styles it, but the clue is the class change.
